import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

def task_func(
    feature_array,
    target_array,
    feature_names=["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5"],
    target_name="target",
    seed=None,
):
    if seed is not None:
        np.random.seed(seed)
        
    shuffled_indices = np.random.permutation(feature_array.shape[1])
    shuffled_array = feature_array[:, shuffled_indices]
    
    X = pd.DataFrame(shuffled_array, columns=feature_names)
    y = pd.Series(target_array, name=target_name)
    
    clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=seed)
    clf.fit(X, y)
    
    return clf
